## Standing operator rules
- Goal for this session: upgrade SQLAlchemy from 1.4 to 2.0 across the ledgerly models.
- Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.
- Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.
- Separately, run “Kafka repartition offset migration” in between other work, following all nine supplied steps in order, one at a time, to migrate `orders.v1` to `orders.v2`, replay records, and switch `orders-v1` to `orders-v2`.
- Put the SQLAlchemy upgrade on hold. Switch to adding a CSV import for vendor credits in ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py; finance needs it this week.
- Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Recent work
Invoice listing now supports validated `limit`/`offset` pagination, returns `{items,total,limit,offset}`, and has schema/service/route changes plus pagination tests; all 9 invoice API tests and 3 new pagination tests pass. The billing idempotency race fix is committed, formatting passes, and integration/full suites pass. Vendor-credit CSV import remains active; continue Kafka steps separately.
